text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Dh’innis prìomh sgrùdaire RSPCA na Cuimrigh Nuadh a Deas, David Ó Seachnasaigh, dha ABC gum bu chòir do chaithris agus sgrùdadh de thaighean-spadaidh ann an Astràilia a bhith cumanta.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: “Bhiodh CCTV na shanas mòr dhan fheadhainn a bhios ag obair le beathaichean gur e am math-san am prìomhachas as àirde.”
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Cha robh mapa eadar-nàiseanta nan crith-thalmhainn le Suirbhidh Geòlasach nan Stàitean Aonaichte a’ sealltainn crith-thalmhainn sam bith ann an Innis Tìle an t-seachdain roimhe sin.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Dh’aithris Oifis Sìde Innis Tìle cuideachd nach robh crithean-talmhainn ann an sgìre Hekla sna 48 uairean seo a chaidh seachad.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Thachair a’ ghnìomhachd crithe-talmhainn mhòr a dh’adhbharaich atharrachadh an fhàsa air an 10mh latha dhen Mhàrt air taobh ear-thuath a’ chaldara aig mullach na beinne-teine.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Chaidh aithris a dhèanamh air neòil dhorcha aig bonn na beinne aig nach robh buntainneas sam bith do ghnìomhachd beinne-teine.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Bha cunnart nach biodh e soilleir an robh spreadhadh ann gus nach robh an cois nan neul.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Bha eadar 120 is 160 meatair ciùbach de chonnadh air bòrd an Luno nuair a bhris i agus nuair a shèid gaoth làidir agus tuinn mhòra ris a’ bhalla-fhasgaidh e.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Theasraig heileacoptairean an 12 neach-sgioba agus cha robh de dhochann ann ach sròn bhriste.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: Bha an long a bha 100 meatair a dh’fhaid air an t-slighe a thogail a luchd àbhaisteach de thodhar gallda agus bha eagal air na h-oifigich an toiseach gun robh cunnart ann gun taomadh an luchd far an t-soithich.
text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Chaidh an t-atharrachadh a mholar aontachadh leis an dà thaigh a-cheana ann an 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Chaidh atharrachadh a dhèanamh san t-seisean reachdail seo nuair a chaidh an dàrna seantans a dhubhadh às an toiseach le Taigh nan Riochdairean agus an uair sin chaidh gabhail ris ann an cruth gu math coltach ris san t-Seanadh Diluain.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Leis gun do dh’fhàillig an dàrna seantans a tha a’ moladh toirmeasg de dh’aonaidhean sìobhalta aon-ghnèitheach, dh’fhaoidte gum fosgail sin doras do dh’aonaidhean sìobhalta san àm ri teachd.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: A’ leantainn a’ phròiseis, thèid ath-sgrùdadh a dhèanamh air HJR-3 ro thaghadh na h-ath-reachdadaireachd ann an 2015 no 2016 airson fuireach sa phròiseas.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: Tha euchdan Vautier taobh a-muigh stiùireadh a’ gabhail a-steach stailc acrais ann an 1973 an aghaidh na bha e a’ faicinn mar chaisgireachd phoilitigeach.
text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: Chaidh lagh na Frainge atharrachadh. Thòisich na h-iomairtean aige aig aois 15 nuair a ghabh e ann an Aghaidheachd na Frainge anns an Dàrna Cogadh.
text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: Sgrìobh e mu dheidhinn fhèin ann an leabhar a chaidh fhoillseachadh ann an 1998.
text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Anns na 1960an thill e gu Algeria, a bha dìreach air a neo-eisimeileachd fhaighinn, gus stiùireadh fhilmichean a theagasg.
text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Chaochail an judoka Seapanach Hitoshi Saito, a bhuannaich dà bhonn òir aig na Geamannan Oilimpigeach, aig aois 54.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Chaidh ainmeachadh gur e aillse an duct domlais eadra-ghrùthanach adhbhar a’ bhàis.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Chaochail e ann an Ōsaka Dimàirt.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: A thuilleadh air a bhith na sheann-churaidh nan geamannan Oilimpeach is an t-Saoghail, bha Saito na chathraiche air comataidh trèanaidh Chaidreachas Judo Uile-Iapanach aig àm a bhàis.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Bha co-dhiù 100 duine aig a’ phàrtaidh airson ciad cheann-bliadhna de chàraid a chomharradh a chùm am banais an-uiridh.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Thuirt na h-oifigich gun deach comharradh foirmeil a’ chinn-bhliadhna a ghluasad gu ceann-là eile.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Phòs a’ chàraid ann an Texas bliadhna air ais agus thàinig iad a Bhuffalo airson a chomharradh còmhla ri caraidean is luchd-dàimh.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Bha an duine aice a bha 30 bliadhna a dh’aois ’s a rugadh ann am Buffalo air aon den cheathrar a chaidh a mharbhadh san losgadh, ach cha deach a bhean a ghoirteachadh.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: S e oide Beurla iomraiteach ach connspaideach a th’ ann an Karno a theagaisg fo fhoghlam ùr agus glòr an rìgh agus a tha a’ cumail a-mach gun robh 9,000 oileanach aige aig bàrr a’ chùrsa-obrach.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Chleachd e faclan sna nòtaichean aige a bha garbh am beachd cuid a phàrantan agus chaidh aithris gun do chleachd e droch chainnt sna clasaichean aige.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Thog Modern Education air gun do chlò-bhuail e sanasan-reic mòra air busaichean gun chead agus gun do dh’innis e breug le bhith ag ràdh gum b’ esan prìomh oide na Beurla.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Thathar cuideachd air cur às a leth gun do bhris e riaghailtean còir-lethbhreac, ged nach tugadh e fo chasaid.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Thuirt seann oileanach gum biodh e “a’ cleachdadh truaill-chainnt anns a’ chlas”, gum biodh e “a’ teagasg sgilean a thaobh dating ann an nòtaichean”, agus gun robh e “mar charaid do na h-oileanaich.”
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Leasaich an t-Sìn eaconamaidh margaide sna trì deicheadan seo chaidh ged a tha e fhathast na stàit chomannach gu h-oifigeil.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Chaidh na ciad ath-leasachaidhean eaconamach a dhèanamh fo cheannardas Deng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Bhon uair sin, tha meud eaconamaidh Shìona air fàs an 90mh uiread.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Airson a’ chiad uair, rinn Sìona às-mhalairt an-uiridh de bharrachd chàraichean na a’ Ghearmailt agus thug iad bàrr air na Stàitean Aonaichte mar am margadh as motha don ghnìomhachas seo.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Dh’fhaodadh làn-thoradh Shìona (GDP) bàrr a thoirt air na Stàitean Aonaichte an taobh a-staigh fichead bliadhna.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Tha Stoirm Thropaigeach Danielle, a’ cheathramh stoirm ainmichte de ràith nan doineannan Atlantaigeach 2010, air tàrmachadh ann an taobh an ear a’ Chuain Shiar.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Bha sìor ghaoth aig astar 40mph (64kph) aig an stoirm, mu 3,000 mìle air falbh o Mhiami, Florida.
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Tha eòlaichean aig Ionad Nàiseanta nan Huracan den bheachd gum meudaich Danielle gu bhith na làn huracan ro Dhiciadain.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: A chionn ’s gu bheil an stoirm fada air falbh o thalamh, tha e fhathast duilich measadh a dhèanamh air a’ bhuaidh a dh’fhaodadh e toirt air na SA no air na h-Eileanan Caraibeach.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Rugadh Bobek ann an ceanna-bhaile na Croatia, Zagreb, agus choisinn e cliù a’ cluich airson Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Ghabh e air thuarastal aca ann an 1945 agus dh’fhan e gus 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Fhad ’s a bha e san sgioba, rinn e 403 tadhal ann an 468 geama.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Cha do nochd duine sam bith nas trice airson an sgioba, is cha do chuir duine sam bith barrachd thadhlan dha na Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Chaidh a bhòtadh ann an 1995 na chluicheadair Partizan as fheàrr a bh’ ann riamh.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Thòisich an greadhnas is cluich shònraichte le Cirque de Soleil, còmhlan a tha aithnichte air feadh an t-saoghail.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Bha e ga leantainn le Orcastra Simphnidh Stàit Istanbul, còmhlan-ciùil Janissary agus na seinneadairean Fatih Erkoç agus Müslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Thàinig na cuairt-dhàrbhaisean air an àrd-ùrlar an uairsin.
text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: Sheinn an diobha Thurcach Sezen Aksu leis an tenor Eadailteach Alessandro Safina agus an seinneadair Ghreugach Haris Alexiou.
text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Chuir an còmhlan-dannsaidh Tuirceach “Teine Anatolia” clach-mhullaich air cùisean leis an t-sealladh “Tròidh”.
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Chaochail Peter Lenz, fear-rèisidh motar-rothair aois 13, an dèidh tubaiste aig an Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Fhad ’s a bha e ga bhlàthachadh, thuit Lenz far a’ bhaidhg agus bhuail an co-rèisear Xavier Zayat ann.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Fhritheil aon dhen luchd-obrach meadaigeach air an rèile ris sa bhad agus chaidh a thoirt gu ospadal ionadail far an do chaochail e às a dhèidh sin.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Cha deach Zayat a dhochann san tubaist.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: A thaobh an t-suidheachaidh ionmhasail eadar-nàiseanta, thuirt Zapatero an uairsin “gu bheil an rian ionmhasail na phàirt dhen eaconamaidh, pàirt riatanach.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Tha èiginn ionmhasail bliadhna againn agus bha an t-àm as èiginniche againn dheth san dà mhìos seo chaidh agus saoilidh mi gu bheil na margaidean ionmhasail a’ dol am feabhas an-dràsta.”
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Chuir Naked News an cèill an t-seachdain seo chaidh gun leudaich iad am mandat chànan eadar-nàiseanta aca gu mòr, a’ gabhail a-steach aithrisean naidheachdan, le trì craolaidhean ùra.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Tha am buidheann domhanta a’ cur prògraman Spàinntis, Eadailtis is Coirèanais air bhog don telebhisean, eadar-lìon, is innealan-làimhe agus e mar-thà ag aithris ann am Beurla is Iapanais.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Gu fortanach, cha do thachair dad rium fhìn ach chunnaic mi sealladh oillteil is daoine a’ feuchainn ri uinneagan a bhriseadh airson teicheadh às.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Bha daoine a’ bualadh sèithrichean ris na leòsain ach ’s e uinneagan do-bhriste a bh’ annta.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: “Mu dheireadh thall, bhriseadh aon de na leòsan, agus thòisich iad air teicheadh às an uinneag,” thuirt am fear-maireann Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Tha solas agus teas a’ tighinn far rionnagan air sgàth an lùthais a thig às nuair a cho-aonaicheas (no a cho-leaghas) ataman hàidhdreaidein nan eileamaidean nas truime.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Tha eòlaichean ag obair gus readhactar a dhèanamh as urrainn lùth a chruthachadh air an aon dòigh.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Ach, ge-tà, ’s e duilgheadas a bhios doirbh ri fhuasgladh a tha seo agus bidh e mòran bhliadhnaichean mus fhaic sinn readhactaran fiùisein gan togail a bhios gu feum.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Bidh an t-snàthad stàilinn air fleod air uachdar an uisge mar thoradh air teannachadh uachdair.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Tha teanntachd air an uachdar a’ tachairt ri linn ’s gu bheil na moileciuilean uisge air uachdar an uisge gu mòr air an tarraing ri chèile, barrachd na tha iad air an tarraing ris na moileciuilean àile a tha os an cionn.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Nì na moileciuilean uisge craiceann do-fhaicsinneach air uachdar an uisge a nì e comasach do rudan mar snàthad a bhith air fleod air uachdar an uisge.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Tha faobhar dùbailte air an lann bròige-spèilidh an latha an-diugh le lagan fo-chearclach eatarra. Greimichidh an dà fhaobhar ris an deigh nas fheàrr, fiù ma bhios iad air an claonadh.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: A chionn ’s gu bheil bonn an lainn rud beag cam, fhad ’s a tha an lann a’ claonadh an dàrna taobh no an taobh eile, bidh am faobhar a tha beantainn ris an deigh a’ lùbadh cuideachd.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Tha seo a’ cur an spèiliche gu tionndadh. Ma chlaonas na brògan-spèilidh don làimh dheis, tionndaidh an spèiliche don làimh dheis, ma chlaonas na brògan don làimh chlì, tionndaidh an spèiliche don làimh chlì.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Airson tilleadh dhan ìre lùthais far an robh iad roimhe, feumaidh iad cuidhteas fhaighinn dhen lùthas a bharrachd a fhuair iad on t-solas.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Nì iad seo le bhith a’ leigeil às mìr bhìodach solais air a bheil “fòton”.
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: S e “sgaoileadh rèididheachd brosnaichte” a chanas luchd-saidheans ris a’ phròiseas seo a chionn ’s gu bheil na h-ataman air am brosnachadh leis an t-solas shoilleir, is e ag adhbharachadh sgaoileadh foton solais, is gu bheil solas na sheòrsa de rèididheachd.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Anns an ath dhealbh, chithear ataman a’ cur a-mach fhotonan. An da-rìribh, tha fotonan tòrr nas lugha na an fheadhainn san dealbh.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Tha fotonan fiù ’s nas lugha na an stuth às a bheil ataman dèante!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Às dèidh obair fad nan ceudan de dh’uairean a thìde losgaidh an fhileamaid san t-solas aig a cheann thall agus chan obraich am solas tuilleadh.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: An uairsin, feumaidh bolgan-solais eile an àite an fhir a bh’ ann. Tha faiceall a dhìth nuair a bhithear a’ cur a’ bholgain-sholais ùire na àite.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: An toiseach, feumar suids an t-solais a chur dheth no an càball a dhì-cheangal.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Tha seo air sgàth gun urrainn dealan a tha a’ sruthadh a-steach dhan t-socaid far am bi a’ phàirt mheatailteach den bholg a’ suidhe droch chlisgeadh-dealain a thoirt dhut ma bheanas tu ri leth a-staigh na socaid no bonn meatailt a’ bhuilg fhad ’s a tha e fhathast anns an t-socaid gu ìre.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: S e an cridhe am prìomh organ ann an siostam na fala, a bhios a’ pùmpadh na fala.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Tha an fhuil a’ dol air falbh on chridhe ann am pìoban air a bheil cuislean-dearga agus a’ tilleadh dhan chridhe ann am pìoban air a bheil cuislean-gorma. ’S e cuislean-caola a chanar ris na pìoban as lugha.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Bhiodh fiaclan triceratops comasach air a bhith a’ pronnadh chan e a-mhàin duilleagan ach fiù ’s geugan agus freumhaichean gu math cruaidh.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Tha cuid a luchd-saidheans dhen bheachd gun robh triceratops ag ithe saidhceadan, seòrsa de lus a bha cumanta san linn chailceach.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Tha coltas craoibhe-pailm bheag air na lusan seo le crùn de dhuilleagan geura biorach.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: B’ urrainn dha triceratops an gob cruaidh aige a chleachdadh airson na duilleagan a rùsgadh dheth mus itheadh e an stoc.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Tha eòlaichean eile a’ cumail a-mach gu bheil na lusan seo glè phuinnseanta, mar sin chan eil e coltach gun do dh’ith dìneasair sam bith iad, fiù ’s ged as urrainn don lunndaire-craoibhe is beathaichean eile leithid na pioraid (sliochd nan dìneasaran) duilleagan no measan puinnseanta ithe.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Dè an tarraing a bhiodh aig Io orm? Nan seasadh tu air uachdar Io, bhiodh nas lugha de chudrom annad na th’ annad air an Talamh.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Bhiodh cudrom mu thuaiream 36 punnd (16kg) ann an neach air Io ged a bhiodh 200 punnd (90kg) ann air an Talamh. Bhiodh a’ chumhachd-thalmhainn a’ tarraing ort nas lugha gu dearbh mar sin.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Chan eil rùsg aig a’ Ghrian mar a tha aig an Talamh air an urrainn dhut seasamh. Tha a’ Ghrian gu lèir dèanta de ghasaichean, teine, agus plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mar as fhaide air falbh o mheadhan na grèine a bhios tu, ’s ann as taine a tha an gas seo a’ fàs.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: S e a tha anns an roinn as fhaide muigh a chì sinn nuair a choimheadas sinn air a’ ghrian am “photosphere” agus tha sin a’ ciallachadh “balla de sholas”.
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Mu thrì mìle bliadhna an dèidh sin, ann an 1610, chleachd an reul-eòlaiche Galileo Galilei glainne-amhairc ’s chunnaic e gun robh mùthadh solais aig Bhèineas dìreach mar a tha aig a’ ghealach.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Tha mùthaidhean an t-solais ann a chionn ’s gu bheil dìreach taobh Bhèineas (no na gealaich) a tha ris a’ ghrian soillsichte. Chuir mùthadh solas Bhèineas taic ris an teòirig aig Copernicus gu bheil na planaidean ag iadhadh na grèine.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Agus an uairsin, beagan bhliadhnaichean an dèidh sin ann an 1639, chunnaic reul-eòlaiche Sasannach air a bheil Jeremiah Horrocks trasnadh de Bhèineas.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Dh’fhiosraich Sasainn greis fhada na sìthe an dèidh ath-cheannsachadh an Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Ge-tà, ann an 991 b’ fheudar dha Ethelred aghaidh a thoirt air feachd-mara Lochlannach a bha nas motha na fear sam bith eile on fhear aig Guthrum ceud bliadhna roimhe sin.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Bha an cabhlach seo air a stiùireadh le Olaf Trygvasson, Nirribheach aig an robh miann air a dhùthaich a shaoradh o cheannas nan Danmhairgeach.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: An dèidh tillidhean an airm aig an toiseach, b’ urrainn dha Ethelred tighinn gu rèite le Olaf a thill dhan Nirribhidh airson a rìoghachd a chosnadh agus shoirbhich leis gu ìre.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Is e Hangeul an aon aibideil a chaidh a thùradh a dh’aona-gnothach agus a tha air a cleachdadh gu làitheil leis a’ phoball an-diugh. Chaidh an aibideil a thùradh ann an 1444 ri àm rìoghachaidh Rìgh Sejong (1418 – 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Bu Rìgh Sejong an ceathramh rìgh san rìgh-shliochd Joseon agus tha e am measg na feadhainn as urramaiche.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: S e Hunmin Jeongeum a thug e air aibidil Hangeul an toiseach agus tha sin a’ ciallachadh “na fuaimean ceart a chùm teagasg nan daoine”.
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Tha iomadh teòirig ann mu mar a thàinig Sanskrit gu bith. Tha aonan dhiubh ag innse gun robh imrich Arianach ann a thàinig on iar dha na h-Innseachan agus a thug leotha an cànan.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: S e cànan àrsaidh a tha ann an Sanskrit, car coltach ri Laideann a bha ga bruidhinn san Roinn-Eòrpa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Fhad ’s as fhiosrach leinn, chaidh an leabhar a bu tràithe san t-saoghal a sgrìobhadh ann an Sanskrit. An dèidh co-chruinneachadh nan Upanishad, cha do rinn Sanskrit ach seargadh às air sgàth ’s nach robh a h-inbhe mar a b’ àbhaist.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: S e cànan glè thoinnte agus beartach a th’ ann an Sanskrit às an tàinig mòran dhe na cànain Innseanach a th’ againn an-diugh, dìreach mar a tha Laideann na bhun-stèidh airson cànain Eòrpach mar an Fhraingis no Spàinntis.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Leis a’ bhlàr airson na Frainge seachad, rinn a’ Ghearmailt ullachadh airson ionnsaigh a thoirt air eilean Bhreatainn.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Chuir a’ Ghearmailt an t-ainm-còd “Iomairt Leòmhainn Mara” air an ionnsaigh. Chaidh tòrr den armachd throm agus den t-solar aig Arm Bhreatainn a chall nuair a dh’fhàg e Dunkirk, is mar sin bha an t-arm caran lag.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ach bha an Cabhlach Rìoghail fada nas treasa fhathast na Cabhlach na Gearmailte (an “Kriegsmarine”) agus b’ urrainn dha loingeas ionnsaigh sam bith a chuireadh iad thairis air Caolas na Frainge a sgriosadh.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Ge-tà, cha robh ach glè bheag de longan a’ Chabhlaich Rìoghail stèidhichte faisg air na slighean air am briseadh iad a-steach as dòcha a chionn ’s gun robh eagal air na ceannardan-cabhlaich gun rachadh an cur fodha le ionnsaigh-adhair o na Gearmailtich.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Tòisicheamaid le mìneachadh de phlanaichean na h-Eadailt. Bha an Eadailt gu ìre mhòr mar “am bràthair beag” aig a’ Ghearmailt ’s aig Iapan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Is ann leis a bha an t-arm ’s an cabhlach a bu laige, ged a bha iad air ceithir longan ùra a thogail aig àm tòiseachadh a’ chogaidh.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: S ann air dùthchannan Afraganach as motha a bha an Eadailt ag amas. Gus na tìrean sin a ghlacadh, dh’fheumadh àite lainnsidh a bhith aca airson nam feachdan gus am b’ urrainn dhaibh seòladh thairis air a’ mhuir Mheadhan-thìreach gus ionnsaigh a thoirt air Afraga.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Airson sin, b’ fheudar dhaibh cuidhteas fhaighinn dhe na bunaitean is longan Breatannach san Èiphit. A bharrachd air na gnìomhan seo, cha bu chòir do longan-cogaidh na h-Eadailte dad eile a dhèanamh.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Nise, a thaobh na Seapaine. ’S e dùthaich eilein a bha san t-Seapan, dìreach mar a tha Breatainn.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: S e longan a chaidh a dhealbhadh airson siubhal fon uisge a th’ ann am bàtaichean-tumaidh agus fanaidh iad ann fad ùine gu math fada.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Bhathar a’ cleachdadh bhàtaichean-aigeil sa Chogadh Mhòr agus san Dàrna Cogadh. Cha robh na bàtaichean ach mall an uair ud agus bha an raon-bualaidh nan gunnaichean aca ro-ghoirid.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Mu thùs a’ chogaidh bhiodh iad mar bu trice a’ siubhal air uachdar a’ chuain, ach nuair a dh’fhàs an ràdar nas adhartaiche ’s nas cuimsiche, b’ fheudar do na bàtaichean-aigeil a dhol fo uisge gus nach fhaicteadh iad.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Bhathar a’ toirt U-Boats air bàtaichean-aigeil Gearmailteach. Bha na Gearmailteach fìor mhath air na “longan-fo-mhuir” seo a threòrachadh ’s obrachadh.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Air sgàth ’s gun robh iad cho soirbheachail leis na bàtaichean-aiginn, cha robh earbsa sna Gearmailtich cus dhiubh a bhith aca an dèidh a’ chogaidh.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Seadh! ’S e an Righ Tutankhamun, air am bi “An Rìgh Tut” no “An Rìgh a bha na Bhalach” fear de na Rìghrean Èipheiteach Àrsaidh as aithnichte san linn againn.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Tha e inntinneach nach robhar ga mheas ro chudromach anns an t-seann aimsir agus nach do nochd e anns a’ mhòr-chuid de chlàran-eachdraidh nan rìghrean.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Ach dh’fhàs e ainmeil nuair a chaidh a thuama a lorg ann an 1922. Ged a chaidh mòran thuaman a chreachadh san àm a dh’fhalbh, bha an tuama aigesan cha mhòr mar a bha e an toiseach.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Tha a bheag no mhòr de na nithean a chaidh adhlacadh le Tutankhamun air an deagh ghleidheadh tèarainte, nam measg sin, na mìltean de dh’ulaidhean dèante de mheatailtean prìseil is leugan tearca.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Dh’fhàg innleachadh na fearsaide cuibhle feunan nan Asirianach nas aotruime, nas luaithe agus nas uidheamaichte airson saighdearan is feunan eile fhàgail nan deireadh.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Bha na saighdean bho na crois-bhoghachan bàsail aca comasach air drùidheadh tro armachd saighdearan an nàmhad. Mu 1000 R.C., thug na Asirianaich a-steach a’ chiad mharc-shluagh.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: S e arm a tha a’ sabaid air muin each a th’ ann an eachraidh. Cha robh an dìollaid air innleachadh agus rinn an t-eachraidh Asirianach sabaid o mhuin lom nan each aca.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Tha sinn eòlach air mòran luchd-poileataigs, luchd-saidheans is luchd-ealain Greugach. ’S dòcha gur e Hòmair an neach ais aithnichte dhen chultar seo, am bàrd dall ainmeil a chruthaich dà annas-làimhe litreachas na Grèige: an Iliad agus laoidh Odusseus.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Tha Sophocles agus Aristophanes nan dràmadaichean fèillmhor fhathast agus tha na dealbhan-cluiche aca air am meas am measg nan obraichean litreachais as motha air an t-saoghal.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Is e am fear-matamataigs Pythagoras Grèigeach cliùiteach eile a tha aithnichte sa chumantas airson an teòirim ainmeil aige mu na dàimhean eadar taobhan nan triantan ceart-cheàrnach.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Tha diofar thuairmsean ann mun àireamh de dhaoine aig a bheil Hindis. Thathar a’ tomhas gur e Hindis an treas cànan as bitheanta ga bruidhinn air an t-saoghal.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Tha àireamh nan daoine aig a bheil i on ghlùin a’ crochadh air a’ cheist am bu chòir dual-chainntean nach eil cho faisg an dàimh a bhith a-staigh san àireamh.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Tha na tuairmeasan air an luchd-labhairt eadar 340 millean is 500 millean agus tuigidh suas ri 800 millean duine an cànan.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Tha Hindi is Urdu gu math coltach ri chèile a thaobh briathrachais ach tha iad sgrìobhte le sgriobt eadar-dhealaichte; ann an còmhraidhean làitheil, is urrainn do luchd-labhairt aig an dà chànan càch a chèile a thuigsinn mar as trice.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Mun 15mh linn, bha Estòinia mu thuath fo bhuaidh mhòr chultarach na Gearmailt.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Bu mhiann le cuid de na manaich Ghearmailteach Dia a thoirt nas dlùithe do mhuinntir an àite, mar sin, dh’inntrig iad cànan litireil Eastonais.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Chaidh a stèidheachadh air an aibidil Ghearmailtis agus chaidh aon litir “Õ/õ” a chur ris.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Nuair a chaidh an ùine seachad, thàinig mòran fhaclan iasad bhon Ghearmailtis còmhla. B’ e seo toiseach an t-Soillseachaidh.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Gu traidiseanta, bhiodh oighre na rìgh-cathrach a’ dol air adhart dhan arm às dèidh dha crìochnachadh san sgoil.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: A dh’aindeoin seo, chaidh Teàrlach dhan oilthigh ann an Colaiste na Trianaid, Cambridge is rinn Antrap-eòlas agus Àrc-eòlas, agus às dèidh sin Eachdraidh, a’ cosnadh ceum 2:2 (ceum dàrna clas nas ìsle).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: B’ e Teàrlach a’ chiad bhall de theaghlach rìoghail Bhreatainn a fhuair ceum.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Tha an Tuirc Eòrpach (Thrace an ear no Rumelia san rubha Bhàlcanach) a’ gabhail a-steach 3% den dùthaich.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Tha ranntair na Tuirce còrr is 1,600 cileameatair (1,000 mìle) a dh’fhaid agus 800 km (500 mìle) a leud, agus air chumadh a tha a bheag no mhòr ceart-cheàrnach.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Tha 783,562 cilemeatair ceàrnagach (300,948 mi2) san Tuirc, a’ gabhail a-staigh nan lochan, agus tha 755,688 cilemeatair ceàrnagach (291,773 mi2) dheth ann an Àisia an iar-dheas agus 23,764 cilemeatair ceàrnagach (9,174 mi2) san Roinn-Eòrpa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: S e an Tuirc an 37mh dùthaich as motha san t-saoghal mar thoradh air a meud, agus tha i mun aon mheud ri Fraing na Roinn-Eòrpa agus an Rìoghachd Aonaichte còmhla.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Tha muir air trì taobhan na Tuirce: Am Muir Àigeanach san iar, am Muir Dubh mu thuath agus am Muir Meadhanach mu dheas.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Tha eachdraidh fhada aig Lugsamburg ach chaidh i neo-eisimeileach ann an 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bha cuid de na h-àiteachan a tha anns a’ Bheilg san latha an-diugh nam pàirt de Lugsamburg san àm a dh’fhalbh ach bha iad nam pàirtean den Bheilg às dèidh Ar a-mach na Beilge anns na 1830an.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Rinn Lugsamburg a dhìcheall airson a bhith na dhùthaich neodrach an-còmhnaidh ach chaidh a cheannsachadh leis a’ Ghearmailt an dà chuid sa chiad chogadh mhòr agus san dàrna cogadh mòr.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Bha Lugsamburg, ann an 1957, am measg nam ball a chuir am buidheann air chois air a bheil an t-Aonadh Eòrpach an-diugh.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: S e tobhta gearastain agus manachainn Bhudach ann an sgìre uachdarach ceàrn Paro (ann an clachan Phoney) a th’ anns an Drukgyal Dzong.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Thathar ag ràdh gun do chruthaich Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel an gearastan ann an 1649 gus a bhuaidh an aghaidh feachdan Tibetach-Mongolach a chomharrachadh.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: An 1951, cha do dh’fhàg teine ach cuid de dh’fhuidheall Drukgyal Dzong, leithid ìomhaigh Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Chaidh obair-ghlèidhteachais a dhèanamh air a’ ghearastan an dèidh an teine agus chaidh a dhìon is tha e fhathast am measg nan culaidhean-iongnaidh as mìorbhailiche ann am Butàn.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Anns an 18mh linn bha Cambuidea fo bhrùthadh eadar dà nàbaidh chumhachdach, Dùthaich nan Tàidh agus Bhiet-Nam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Thug muinntir nan Tàidh ionnsaigh air Cambuidea grunn tursan san 18mh linn agus sgrios iad Phnom Penh ann an 1772.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Thug muinntir Bhiet-Nam ionnsaigh air Cambuidea sna bliadhnaichean mu dheireadh dhen 18mh linn cuideachd.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Tha ochd deug sa cheud de mhuinntir na Bheiniseala gun obair agus tha a’ chuid as motha dhen fheadhainn aig a bheil cosnadh ag obair san eaconamaidh neo-fhoirmeil.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Bidh dà anns gach trì de muinntir Bheiniseala aig a bheil obair air am fastadh ann an seirbheisean, tha faisg air aonan anns gach ceathrar ag obair ann an gnìomhachas is tha an còigeamh cuid ag obair an àiteachas.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Tha an ola na ghnìomhachas cudromach do Bheinisealaich is an dùthaich na às-phortaiche lom ged nach eil ach mu aon sa chiad ag obair ann an gnìomhachas na h-ola.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Aig toiseach an neo-eisimeileachd nàiseanta, bha an t-eòlas aig Lios Luibheach Singapore na chuideachadh gus an t-eilean a chruth-atharrachadh agus a dhèanamh na bhaile gàrraidh tropaigeach.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Chaidh mogairle thar-chinealach, Vanda Miss Joaquim, a thaghadh mar fhlùr nàiseanta an nàisein ann an 1981.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tha cha mhòr 1.5 millean lus-itheadair a’ dol a dh’ionnsaigh nam machraichean a deas an tòir an uisge gach bliadhna mun Dàmhair, a’ dol thairis air abhainn Mara, a’ tighinn o na cnuic a tuath.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: An uairsin air ais don taobh a tuath tron àird an iar, a’ gabhail tarsaing air abhainn Mara uair eile, an dèidh ràith sileadh an uisge mu thimcheall a’ Ghiblein.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Ann an ceàrn Serengeti, gheibhear Pàirc Nàiseanta Serengeti, Raon Glèidhteachais Ngorongoro agus Tèarmann Sìthne Maswa san Tansan agus Tèarmann Nàiseanta Maasai Mara ann an Ceinia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Airson cruthachadh mheadhanan eadar-ghnìomhach ionnsachadh, feumaidh sinn sgilean gnàthach, traidiseanta agus innleachdan a fhuaras ann an clasaichean eadar-ghnìomhach (bòrd-stòiridh, deasachadh fuaim is video, seanchas, msaa.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Tha dealbhadh eadar-ghnìomhach a’ toirt ort ath-chnuasachadh a dhèanamh air do bheachdan a thaobh riochdachadh mheadhanan agus ionnsachadh a bhith a’ smaoineachadh air dòighean neo-dhìreach.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Tha dealbhadh eadar-obrachail ag iarraidh co-phàirtean pròiseict a bhith co-cheangailte, ach cuideachd gun dèan iad ciall mar eintiteas air leth.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: S e an èis air lionsaichean sùm gu bheil iom-fhillteachd an fhòcais agus an àireamh de dh’eileamaidean lionsa a dh’fheumar airson rainse de dh’fhaidean fòcais fhaighinn fada nas motha na ann an lionsa socraichte.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chan eil an duilgheadas seo cho cumanta ’s a b’ àbhaist oir tha luchd-saothrachaidh lionsaichean a’ ruigsinn ìrean càileachd nas àirde ann an dèanamh lionsaichean.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Thug seo cothrom do lionsaichean sùmaidh a bhith a’ togail dhealbhan de mhathas a ghabhas coimeasadh ris na dealbhan a thog lionsaichean le fad fòcais suidhichte.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Is e ana-cothrom eile aig lionsaichean sùma gu bheil am fosgladh as àirde (luaths) aig an lionsa nas ìsle mar as trice.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Tha e doirbh ri linn seo lionsaichean sùm neo-dhaor a chleachdadh ann an solas ìseal as aonais solais-bhoillsgidh.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Tha tar-sganadh air fear de na duilgheadasan as bitheanta nuair a thathar a’ feuchainn ri film a thionndadh gu cruth DVD.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Tha a’ chuid as motha dhe na telebhiseanan air an dèanamh air dòigh a chòrdas ris a’ phoball.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Air sgàth sin, tha na h-iomaill air an gearradh de gach rud a chì thu air an TBh, am bàrr, am bonn agus an dà thaobh.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Nithear seo a dhèanamh cinnteach gu bheil an dealbh a’ dol tarsainn na sgrìn air fad. ’S e tar-sganadh a chanar ri seo.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Gu mì-fhortanach, nuair a chruthaicheas tu DVD, tha na h-iomallan buailteach a bhith air an gearradh cuideachd, agus nan robh fo-thiotalan sa video ro dhlùth ris a’ bhonn, cha rachadh an sealltainn uile gu lèir.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Tha caisteal tradaiseanta nam Meadhan-aoisean air ar mac-meanmna a bhrosnachadh o chionn fhada, a’ cur dealbhan de ghiustal, ròicean is ridireachd Artaireach nar n-inntinnean.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Ged a sheasadh tu am measg tobhtaichean a tha mìle bliadhna a dh’aois, tha e furasta na fuaimean is fàilidhean aig na cathan o shean a thoirt gu inntinn, gus nach mòr an cluinnear stiream-starum nan each air na clachan càsaichte agus am blaisear an t-eagal a bhiodh ag èirigh on toll-dhubh sa chaisteal.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ach a bheil ar mac-meanmna stèidhichte air an t-saoghal fhìrinneach? Carson a chaidh caistealan a thogail sa chiad dol a-mach? Ciamar a chaidh an dealbhadh is an togail?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Mar a bha àbhaisteach aig an àm, is e taigh daingnichte a th’ ann an Caisteal Kirkby Muxloe seach fìor chaisteal.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Cha sheasadh uinneagan glainneach mòra is a bhallachan tana airson ùine mhòir fo ionnsaigh dhìoghrasach.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Nuair a chaidh tòiseachadh air togail na dùthcha sna 1480an leis a’ Mhorair Hastings, bha i reusanta sìtheil agus cha robh dìon a dhìth ach an aghaidh dròbhan beaga de spùinneadairean air allaban.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Bha cothromachadh na cumhachd na rian anns an robh nàiseanan na Roinn-Eòrpa a’ feuchainn ri flaitheas nàiseanta gach stàit Eòrpach a ghlèidheadh.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: S e an coincheap a bh’ ann gum bu chòir do gach nàisean Eòrpach dèanamh cinnteach nach fhàsadh aon nàisean eile ro chumhachdach agus ri linn sinn, ghluais na riaghaltasan nàiseanta o chaidreachas gu caidreachas gu tric airson cothromachadh a ghlèidheadh.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: B’ e Cogadh Oighre na Spàinn a’ chiad chogadh far an robh cothromachadh cumhachd aig a theis-meadhan.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Bha seo na atharrachadh mòr, oir cha robh an leisgeul aig cumhachdan na h-Eòrpa tuilleadh gun robh iad ri cogadh mar thoradh air creideimh. Mar sin, ’s e Cogadh nan Trichead Bliadhna an cogadh mu dheireadh a bhiodh air a chomharrachadh mar chogadh creideimh.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Chaidh teampall Artemis aig Ephesus a mhilleadh nuair a chuir Herostratus na smàl e air 21 Iuchar, 356 RC.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: A rèir na sgeulachd seo, b’ e cliù a bhrosnaich e, ge be dè a’ chosgais. Dh’èigh na h-Eaphaisich, ’s iad air bhàinidh, nach rachadh ainm Herostratus a chlàradh gu sìorraidh bràth.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Rinn an eachdraiche Grèigeach Strabo nòta den ainm nas anmoiche agus mar sin, tha e aithnichte dhuinn an-diugh. Chaidh an teampall a sgrios air an dearbh oidhche a rugadh Alasdair Uaibhreach.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Thairg Alasdair, mar an rìgh, airgead airson an teampall ath-thogail ach chaidh a dhiùltadh. An dèidh a bhàis, chaidh an teampall ath-thogail na b’ fhaide air adhart ann an 323 ro Chrìosd.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Dèan cinnteach gu bheil do làmh lasaichte gu leòr fhad ’s a tha thu a’ bualadh air na puingean-ciùil gu ceart – cuideachd a’ feuchainn gun cus gluasadan coimheach a dhèanamh led mheòirean.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: San dòigh seo, cha bhi thu idir cho sgìth. Cuimhnich nach leig thu leas na h-iuchraichean a bhualadh gu làidir airson àirde fuaime mar a dh’fheumas tu air piàno.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Air a’ bhogsa-chiùil, airson àirde na fuaime, cuiridh tu barrachd brùthadh sna builg-shèididh no barrachd astair.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: San fhàidheantas, thathar an tòir coimhearsnachd co-chomann no co-ionannachd le no aire mhothachail do dh’fhìorachd, diadhachd, fìrinn spioradail no Dia.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Tha an creidmheach a’ dol an lorg air fèin-fhiosrachadh, eòlas, no tuigse air fìorachd dhiadhaidh no air an dia no diathan.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Tha an luchd-leantainn a’ leantainn dòighean-beatha no gnàthasan àraidh a dh’àraicheas an t-seòrsa seo de dh’fhèin-fhiosrachadh.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Gabhaidh fàidheantas a dhealachadh o riochdan eile de chreideamh is adhradh leis a’ chuideam a tha e a’ leigeil air an eòlas phearsanta dìreach a chuirear air cor mothachaidh air leth, gu h-àraidh an seòrsa cor a tha sìtheil, lèirsinneach, àghmhor, no fiù ’s àrd-èibhneach.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: S e creideamh à fo-mhòr-thìr nan Innseachan a th’ ann an Sikheachas. Dh’èirich e ann an sgìre Panjab rè na 15mh linn à sgaradh seictearach am broinn an tradaisein Hionduthaich.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Tha na Sikhichean dhen bheachd gur e creideamh fa leth on Hionduthachd a tha nan creideamh, ged a tha iad ag aideachadh gu bheil freumhan is tradaiseanan Hionduthach aige.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Their na Sikhean “Gurmat” ris a’ chreideamh aca a tha na fhacal Punjabi air rathad a’ ghùru”. Is e an gùru eileamaid bhunaiteach den a h-uile creideamh Innseanach ach ann an creideamh nan Sikh, tha e cho cudromach ’s gu bheil e mar phrìomh-bhunait nan creideasan Sikheach.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Chaidh an creideamh a chur air bhonn san 15mh linn le Gùru Nanak (1469–1539). Thàinig naoidh gùruthan eile na dhèidh.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Ge-tà, chaidh gill Khrushchev a chur fo dheuchainn san Ògmhios 1956 nuair a thionndaidh aimhreit sa Phòlainn, far an robh luchd-obrach ag èirigh an aghaidh gainnead bìdh agus gearraidhean tuarastail, na ghràcalas an aghaidh Comannachd.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Ged a sheòl Khrushchev tancaichean ann airson òrdugh a thilleadh aig a’ cheann thall, ghèill e do ghrunn tagraidhean eaconamach agus dh’aontaich e Władysław Gomułka, air an robh meas aig mòran, ainmeachadh mar am prìomh mhinistear ùr.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: S e sìobhaltas Linn an Umha a bh’ ann an sìobhaltas Ghleann Indus ann an iar-thuath fo-mhòr-thìr nan Innseachan a ghabh a-staigh a’ chuid as motha de Phagastàn ar latha-ne agus cuid a cheàrnaidhean ann an iar-thuath nan Innseachan agus ear-thuath Afghanastàn.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Bhlàthaich an t-sìobhaltachd ann an srath Abhainn Indus far a bheil an t-ainm aige a’ freumhachadh.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Ged a tha cuid a sgoilearan a’ baralachadh gum bu chòir, leis gun robh an sìobhaltas seo cuideachd ann am miasaid Abhainn Sarasvati a tha tioram an-diugh, an t-ainm Sìobhaltas Indus-Sarasvati a bhith air, tha feadhainn eile a’ cur Sìobhaltas Harappa air a rèir Harappa, aon dhe na ciad làraichean a chaidh a chladhach sna 1920an.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Bhrosnaich nàdar mìlidheachasail ìmpireachd na Ròimhe adhartasan meadaigeach.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Thòisich an Ìmpire Augustus air dotairean a thrusadh agus stèidhich e fiù a’ chiad fheachd meadaigeach Ròmanach airson an cur gu feum an dèidh bhlàran.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Bha làmh-lèighean eòlach air diofar cungaidhean-ciùineachaidh, a’ gabhail a-staigh moirfin a fhuair iad à sìl a’ chrom-luis agus sgopolaimin à sìl a’ ghafainn.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Dh’fhàs iad comasach air buill-bhodhaig a ghearradh air falbh gus euslaintich a shàbhaladh bho chnàmhainn a bharrachd air tòrnaicean agus clabhd cuisleach gus stad a chur air sruthadh fala.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Thar iomadh linn, rinn ìmpireachd na Ròimhe buannachdan mòra anns an raon leigheis agus chruthaich iad mòran den eòlas a th’ againn an-diugh.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: S e origami a th’ ann am Pureland origami le riaghailtean a tha ag ràdh nach urrainn dhut barrachd air aon phasgadh a dhèanamh aig an aon àm, nach eil pasgadh nas toinnte mar pasgadh contrarra ceadaichte agus gum feum ionadan neo-cham a bhith aig gach pasgadh.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Chaidh a leasachadh le Iain Mac a’ Ghobhainn sna 1970an airson taic a chumail ri luchd-pasgaidh gun cus eòlais no feadhainn aig an robh comas gluasaid cuingichte.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Bidh clann a’ fàs mothachail air cinneadh agus gnàth-ìomhaighean a thaobh cinneadh aig aois gu math òg agus tha na gnàth-ìomhaighean sin a thaobh cinneadh a’ toirt buaidh air giùlan.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Mar eisimpleir, tha clann aig a bheil fèin-aithne mion-chuid cinnidh mu bheil gnàth-ìomhaighean nach bi iad a’ dèanamh gu math san sgoil buailteach gun a bhith a’ dèanamh gu math san sgoil aon uair ’s gun ionnsaich iad mun ghnàth-ìomhaigh a tha co-cheangailte ris a’ chinneadh aca.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: S e MySpace an treas làrach-lìn as mòr-chòrdte sna Stàitean Aonaichte agus tha 54 millean pròifil air an-dràsta.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Chaidh mòran aire a thoirt air na làraichean-lìn seo, gu sònraichte ann an suidheachaidhean foghlaim.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Tha rudan math ann mu na làraichean-lìn seo, a’ gabhail a-staigh comas duilleag a shuidheachadh do chlas, le blogaichean, videothan, dealbhan is rudan eile, gun duilgheadas sam bith.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Gheibhear cothrom air an duilleig seo gu furasta le dìreach aon URL, a tha ga dhèanamh furasta a chuimhneachadh is furasta a thaidhpeadh a-steach airson nan oileanach aig a bheil duilgheadas le bhith a’ cleachdadh mheur-chlàr no a bhith a’ litreachadh.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Gabhaidh a ghnàthachadh gus a dhèanamh furasta a leughadh agus cuideachd leis an uiread de dhath ’s a thogras tu.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: S e “sionndrom niùro-eòlach” a th’ ann am mì-rian an dìth-aire “aig a bheil trì comharran clasaigeach, a’ gabhail a-staigh spreigeantachd, so-bhuaireachd agus fothalanachd no lùthas thar a’ chòrr”.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Chan e ciorram ionnsachaidh a th’ ann, ’s e easbhaidh ionnsachaidh a th’ ann; “a bheir buaidh air 3 gu 5 sa cheud de chloinn uile, is dòcha suas ri 2 mhillean chlann Ameireaganach”.
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Tha clann air a bheil ADD a’ faighinn tàire an aire a chumail air nithean mar obair na sgoile, ach gabhaidh iad aire air nithean às am faigh iad tlachd leithid a bhith a’ cluich gheamannan no a’ coimhead nan cartùnaichean as fheàrr leotha no a’ sgrìobhadh seantansan gun phuingeachadh.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Bidh a’ chlann seo ann an aimhreit gu tric oir “gabhaidh iad pàirt ann an giùlan cunnartach, bidh iad an sàs sabaid agus bheir iad dùbhlan air ùghdarras” airson an eanchainnean a bhrodadh a chionn ’s nach gabh an eanchainnean a bhrodadh air na dòighean àbhaisteach.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Tha ADD a’ toirt buaidh air dàimhean le co-aoisich eile leis nach eil clann eile a’ tuigsinn carson a tha an dol a-mach aca mar a tha e, no carson a tha iad a’ speiligeadh san dòigh a tha iad, no gu bheil an ìre abaicheid aca eadar-dhealaichte.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Mar a thàinig atharrachadh air a’ chomas fiosrachadh fhaighinn is ionnsachadh mar a chaidh a mhìneachadh gu h-àrd, thàinig atharrachadh air an reat bhunasach aig an robhar a’ faighinn fiosrachadh.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Bha an dòigh-obrach gus fiosrachadh fhaighinn eadar-dhealaichte. Cha robh e mar uallach air daoine a bhith a’ cuimhneachadh air rudan iad fhèin nas motha, ach bha barrachd fòcas air a’ comas a bhith a’ cuimhneachadh teacsa.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: S e brìgh an sgeòil gun tug an t-Ath-bheòthachadh atharrachadh mòr air ionnsachadh agus sgaoileadh eòlais.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Eu-coltach ri prìomhairean eile, cha bhi homanaidean a-nis a’ cleachdadh an cuid làmhan a chùm falbhain no giùlan cuideim no gluasad tro na craobhan.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Tha làmh is cas an t-siompansaidhe coltach ann am meud agus faid, a’ sealltainn mar a tha an làmh ga cleachdadh gus cuideam a ghiùlan ann an coiseachd chnuimhean.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Tha an làmh dhaonna nas giorra na a’ chas agus le falangasan nas dìriche.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Tha cnàmhan làimhe fosailichte a tha mu dhà gu trì millean bliadhna a dh’aois a’ sealltainn a’ ghluasaid seo ann an speisealachadh na làimhe bho ghluasad gu làimhseachadh.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Tha cuid a dhaoine a’ creidsinn gum fàsar glè chlaoidhte ma bhios cus aislingean làn-mhothachail agad a chaidh an tòiseachadh air alt.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Is e prìomh adhbhar an iongnaidh seo gu bheil na bruadaran làn-mhothachail a’ leudachadh na h-ùine eadar staidean REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: An cois nas lugha de REMs gach oidhche, tha an staid seo anns an dèan thu cadal da-rìribh agus anns an ath-shlànaich do bhodhaig a’ fàs ainneamh gu leòr airson a bhith na dhuilgheadas.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Tha seo a cheart cho sgìtheil ’s nan robh thu ri dùsgadh a h-uile ceann fichead no trithead mionaidean agus a’ coimhead air an telebhisean.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Tha a’ bhuaidh seo an eisimeil air dè cho tric ’s a dh’fheuchas d’ eanchainn ri aisling làn-mhothachail a dhèanamh gach oidhche.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Cha deach cùisean ro mhath do na h-Eadailtich an Afraga a Tuath, cha mhòr bho thùs. Seachdain bho ghairm cogaidh na h-Eadailte air 10 Ògmhios 1940, bha na 11mh Hussars Breatannach air Fort Capuzzo ann an Libia a ghlacadh.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Ann am feall-fhalach ear air Bardia, ghlac na Breatannaich àrd-einnseanair deicheamh arm na h-Eadailte, an Seanailear Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Air 28mh dhen Ògmhios, chaidh àrd-riaghladair Libia agus an t-oighre a bu dòcha do Mhussolini, Marshall Italo Balbo, a mharbhadh le urchairean o fheachdan càirdeil nuair a bha e a’ tighinn a laighe ann an Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Thathar a’ cluich an spòrs nuadh feannsaireachd aig iomadh ìre, bho oileanaich ga togail san oilthigh gu co-fharpaisean proifeiseanta is Oilimpeach.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Thathar a’ cluich an spòrs seo mar chòmhrag dithis a ghnàth, leis an dàrna feannsair a’ co-lannachd ri feannsair eile.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: S e geama anns am bi cluicheadairean a’ bualadh buill do thuill le caman a th’ ann an goilf.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Thathar a’ cluich ochd-deug tuill rè cuairt chunbhalaich, agus ’s àbhaist do chluicheadairean tòiseachadh air a’ chiad toll dhen chùrsa agus crìochnachadh air an ochdamh-deug.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Buannaichidh an cluicheadair aig an robh an àireamh as ìsle de stràcan, no caran dhen bhata, airson an cùrsa a choileanadh.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Tha an iomairt ga cluich air muin feòir, agus thathar a’ bearradh an fheòir timcheall an tuill nas giorra ’s a’ cantainn “lèanag” ris.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: S dòcha gu bheil an rud a chuireas a’ chuid as motha de dhaoine ann an còmhlachas siubhail an seòrsa as cumanta de shiubhal: Turasachd foise.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: S e seo nuair a thèid daoine a dh’àite a tha glè eadar-dhealaichte on bheatha làitheil aca airson fois a ghabhail is spòrs a bhith aca.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Is tric gur e tràighean, pàircean athais agus làraichean campachaidh a th’ anns na h-àiteachan as bitheanta a th’ air an tadhal le luchd-turais a tha a’ sireadh dibhearsan.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Mas e amas tadhail air àite sònraichte eòlas fhaighinn air eachdraidh agus a chultar, canar turasachd chultarach ris an t-seòrsa seo de thurasachd.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Faodaidh luchd-turais tadhal air caochladh ionadan iomraiteach ann an dùthaich àraidh no roghnachadh fuireach dìreach san aon àite.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Air dhaibh sealltainn air a’ ghluasad seo, bha an Luchd-colonachd air èigheachd airson feachdan cùl-taice.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Fhuaras feachdan mar chùl-taice do dh’ionadan bualadh nan lann, nam measg sin, 1d is 3s rèiseamaidean New Hampshire aig an robh 200 duine, fo chomannd nan còirnealan John Stark agus James Reed (a chaidh àrdachadh nan seanailearan an dèidh sin).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Stèidhich saighdearan Stark iad fhèin aig an fheansa aig ceann a tuath àite an luchd-ar-a-mach.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Nuair a dh’fhosgail a’ mhuir-tràigh beàrn a rèir na Mystic River a rèir ear-thuath an leth-eilein, leudaich iad am feansa gun dàil le balla cloiche goirid gu tuath a chrìochnaich aig oir na mara air tràigh bheag.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Chuir Gridley no Stark cipean mu 100 troigh (30m) air beulaibh an fheansa agus thug iad òrdugh gun a bhith a’ tilgeil urchair gus an deach saighdearan an airm cheangailte seachad air.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Chroch plana nan Aimeireaganach air ionnsaigh cho-òrdanaichte a chur gu dol o thrì taobhan eadar-dhealaichte.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Bhiodh an Seanalair John Cadwalder a’ toirt ionnsaigh chlaonaidh air a’ ghearasdan Bhreatannach aig Bordentown, a los cùl-fheachdan sam bith a cheapadh.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Thugadh an Seanailear Seumas MacEòghainn 700 de mhailisidh thairis air an abhainn aig aiseag Trenton, ghlacadh e an drochaid thairis air an Assunpink Creek agus chumadh seo feachdan an nàmhad o theicheadh.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Rachadh am prìomh fheachd ionnsaigh de 2,400 fireannach thairis air an abhainn naoidh mìle tuath air Trenton agus chaidh iad leth is leth an uairsin, an dàrna leth fo Greene agus an leth eile fo Ó Súileabhán, airson ionnsaigh a thoirt ro bhriseadh na fàire.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: A’ dol o ruith cairteal de mhìle gu ruith leth-mhìle, chan eil luaths idir cho cudromach tuilleadh ach tha cian-fhulang dearg-riatanach.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Gu dearbh feumaidh leth-mhìliche den chiad ìre, fear a nì e nas luaithe na dà mhionaid, a bhith gu math luath, ach feumar seasmhachd a bhrosnachadh airson gach cunnairt.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Is e an t-ullachadh as fheàrr ron t-seusan ruithe a bhith ri ruith thar-dùthchail ’s ag obrachadh fèithean bràigh a’ cholainn san taigh-sunntais tron gheamhradh.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Chan urrainn do chleachdaidhean beathachaidh matha a-mhàin sàr-euchdan a thoirt gu buil, ach is urrainn dhaibh buaidh mhòr a thoirt air fallaineachd iomlan nan lùth-chleasaichean òga.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Le cothromachadh lùth fallain, cleachdaidhean uisgeachaidh èifeachdach, is a bhith a’ tuigsinn diofar thaobhan de chleachdaidhean suplamaideach, is urrainn lùth-chleasaichean piseach a thoirt air an dèanadas aca is barrachd tlachd fhaighinn bhon spòrs.
